questions.question_english: The 'Cash Book' in a government school is required to be closed and balanced at what frequency?
options_english: Daily
Annually
Monthly
Weekly
questions.explanation_english: In public financial administration and government school management, the Cash Book is a primary statutory financial register governed by General Financial Rules (GFR). It must be updated, balanced, and closed daily. The Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) or Head of School is legally required to verify daily monetary receipts and disbursements, reconcile the physical cash balance in the chest with the book balance, and sign the cash book at the conclusion of each business day. Monthly bank reconciliation statements are also prepared, but the cash book itself must be closed and authenticated daily. Hence, Option A is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों (GFR) तथा सरकारी शिक्षण संस्थानों के लेखा नियमों के अनुसार, रोकड़ बही (Cash Book) एक अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण विधिक वित्तीय अभिलेख है। विद्यालय में होने वाले प्रत्येक नकद लेनदेन (प्राप्ति एवं भुगतान) को उसी समय दर्ज करना आवश्यक होता है। आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) अथवा संस्था प्रधान द्वारा प्रत्येक कार्य दिवस की समाप्ति पर रोकड़ बही को संतुलित (बैलेंस) करना, बंद करना और तिजोरी में उपलब्ध वास्तविक नकद राशि का मिलान कर हस्ताक्षर द्वारा सत्यापित करना अनिवार्य है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: While conducting a SWOT analysis for a government secondary school, which of the following scenarios would be accurately classified as an 'Opportunity'?
options_english: A newly sanctioned state grant for establishing an advanced ICT computer laboratory
Possessing a core group of highly qualified, dedicated, and experienced teachers
Deteriorating physical building infrastructure and inadequate maintenance of classrooms
Declining student enrollment driven by seasonal demographic population out-migration
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). SWOT Analysis is an environmental scanning framework that categorizes institutional factors across two dimensions: Internal (Strengths and Weaknesses) and External (Opportunities and Threats). Opportunities are favorable external environmental conditions or resources that the institution can capitalize on to improve its performance and growth. A newly announced state grant or government funding initiative for an ICT laboratory originates from the external macro-environment and represents a growth opportunity for the school. In contrast, possessing dedicated faculty is an internal Strength (Option b); crumbling infrastructure is an internal Weakness (Option c); and demographic decline/out-migration causing drops in enrollment is an external Threat (Option d).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। स्वॉट (SWOT) विश्लेषण किसी संस्था के आंतरिक और बाह्य पर्यावरण का व्यवस्थित विश्लेषण करता है। इसमें Strengths (शक्तियां) और Weaknesses (कमजोरियां) संस्था के आंतरिक घटक होते हैं, जबकि Opportunities (अवसर) और Threats (चुनौतियां/खतरे) बाह्य वातावरण से संबंधित होते हैं। 'अवसर' बाह्य परिवेश की ऐसी अनुकूल परिस्थितियाँ या संसाधन हैं जिनका उपयोग संस्था अपने विकास और सुधार के लिए कर सकती है। राज्य सरकार द्वारा स्वीकृत कंप्यूटर/आईसीटी लैब हेतु विशेष अनुदान एक बाह्य अनुकूल घटक है, अतः यह 'अवसर' है। विकल्प (b) योग्य संकाय विद्यालय की आंतरिक 'शक्ति' (Strength) है। विकल्प (c) जर्जर भवन विद्यालय की आंतरिक 'कमजोरी' (Weakness) है। विकल्प (d) जनसांख्यिकीय बदलाव व घटता नामांकन बाह्य 'चुनौती' (Threat) है।

questions.question_english: In educational management, 'Quality Assurance' (QA) fundamentally differs from 'Quality Control' (QC) because:
options_english: Quality Assurance operates reactively by inspecting and identifying institutional deficiencies after task completion.
Quality Assurance relies exclusively on external regulatory bodies and periodic formal inspection visits.
Quality Assurance applies solely to backend operational workflows rather than instructional classroom teaching.
Quality Assurance is a proactive, process-oriented system focused on preventing errors and deficiencies throughout the educational cycle.
questions.explanation_english:
In modern administrative and educational management, the distinction between Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) is centered on proactive prevention versus reactive inspection:
1. Quality Assurance (QA) is proactive and process-oriented. It establishes standardized pedagogical workflows, institutional criteria, teacher development protocols, and curriculum frameworks designed to build quality into every step of education and prevent defects from occurring.
2. Quality Control (QC) is reactive and product/output-oriented. It inspects results (such as grading exams or auditing pass rates after task completion) to detect existing defects.
Therefore, option (d) correctly characterizes Quality Assurance as a proactive, defect-prevention framework.
questions.explanation_hindi:
प्रबंधन सिद्धांतों में 'गुणवत्ता आश्वासन' (Quality Assurance - QA) और 'गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण' (Quality Control - QC) के मध्य का अंतर निवारण (Prevention) बनाम पहचान (Detection) पर आधारित है:
1. गुणवत्ता आश्वासन (QA) एक अग्रसक्रिय (प्रोएक्टिव) तथा प्रक्रिया-उन्मुख (process-oriented) दृष्टिकोण है, जिसका उद्देश्य शैक्षिक योजना, पाठ्यक्रम संचालन एवं प्रशासनिक प्रक्रियाओं को इस प्रकार सुदृढ़ करना है कि प्रारंभ से ही त्रुटियों या कमियों की संभावना को रोका जा सके।
2. गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण (QC) एक प्रतिक्रियात्मक (रिएक्टिव) और परिणाम-उन्मुख (product-oriented) निरीक्षण है, जो कार्य पूर्ण होने के पश्चात अंतिम परिणामों में दोषों की पहचान करता है।
अतः विकल्प (d) सही उत्तर है।

In contrast, Quality Control is a reactive, product-oriented inspection approach that evaluates outcomes after completion to detect errors, making prevention the key distinguishing feature of quality assurance practices.

questions.question_english: The administrative processes of conducting periodic performance reviews and exercising budgetary oversight in school administration fall primarily under which core managerial function?
options_english: Planning
Directing
Organizing
Controlling
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). The 'Controlling' function of management involves four essential steps: (1) establishing performance standards, (2) measuring actual organizational performance, (3) comparing actual results against established standards or budgetary benchmarks, and (4) taking corrective actions to eliminate undesirable variances. Budgetary control and periodic performance reviews are classic controlling mechanisms used by school administrators to ensure that academic outputs, faculty performance, and financial expenditures strictly adhere to the school's approved institutional plans. Option (a), Planning, sets the future benchmarks and policies. Option (b), Directing, provides leadership, motivation, and instruction. Option (c), Organizing, establishes organizational roles and allocates resources.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। प्रबंधन के मूल कार्यों में 'नियंत्रण' (Controlling) का आशय यह सुनिश्चित करने से है कि संस्था की समस्त गतिविधियां पूर्व-निर्धारित योजनाओं और मानकों के अनुरूप चल रही हैं या नहीं। नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया में चार चरण होते हैं: मानकों का निर्धारण, वास्तविक कार्य का मापन, मानकों से वास्तविक कार्य की तुलना, और विचलन पाए जाने पर सुधारात्मक कदम उठाना। कार्य-प्रदर्शन की समीक्षा (Performance review) और बजटीय नियंत्रण (Budgetary control) नियंत्रण के प्रमुख उपकरण हैं, जिनके माध्यम से प्रधानाचार्य यह सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि वित्तीय व्यय और शैक्षणिक परिणाम स्वीकृत बजट और कार्ययोजना के अनुरूप रहें। विकल्प (a) नियोजन भविष्य के लक्ष्य तय करता है। विकल्प (b) निर्देशन कर्मियों को प्रेरित व निर्देशित करता है। विकल्प (c) संगठन कार्यों और संसाधनों का ढांचा तैयार करता है।

questions.explanation_english: Institutional Planning—promoted extensively by the Kothari Commission (1964–66)—is a grassroots, bottom-up planning process initiated by an individual educational institution based on its unique localized needs and realities. Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Educational management is regarded as both a science and an art.
Reason (R): It is founded upon a systematized body of knowledge and principles, while also requiring personal skill, intuition, and creativity in managing human resources.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Management is universally characterized by theorists as both a science and an art. It is a science because it possesses an organized, systematic body of knowledge, universal principles, scientific methods of inquiry, and cause-and-effect relationships. It is simultaneously an art because the successful application of these scientific principles requires personal competence, emotional intelligence, intuitive judgment, tactical adaptation, and situational creativity—especially in educational settings where the primary resource and focus are human beings (teachers, students, and parents). Because Reason (R) directly delineates the exact scientific and artistic attributes that justify Assertion (A), (R) is the true and correct explanation of (A).

questions.question_english: Pursuant to Section 21 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, which of the following statutory mandates governing the composition of the School Management Committee (SMC) is legally required?
options_english: At least 50 percent of the SMC members must be parents or guardians of enrolled students
The school Principal must necessarily serve as the Chairperson of the SMC
At least three-fourths (75 percent) of the SMC members must be parents or guardians of enrolled students
Elected local political representatives must constitute at least 25 percent of the committee membership
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (c). Section 21(1) of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 mandates the constitution of a School Management Committee (SMC) in all government and government-aided schools. To guarantee grassroots democratic community ownership, the statute establishes two unambiguous composition mandates:
1. At least three-fourths (75%) of the total members of the committee must be parents or guardians of children admitted to the school. Furthermore, proportionate representation within this 75% quota must be accorded to parents of children belonging to disadvantaged groups and weaker sections.
2. At least fifty percent (50%) of the total committee members must be women.

Option (a) incorrectly attributes 50% to parental representation; 50% is the statutory gender reservation quota for women, whereas parental representation is set strictly at 75%. Option (b) is contrary to model RTE rules, which specify that the Chairperson must be elected from among the parent members, while the Principal/head teacher usually functions as the Member-Secretary. Option (d) is legally inaccurate as local authority representatives (Panchayati Raj or Urban Local Body members) form only a modest fraction of the remaining 25% non-parent contingent.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (c) है। निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य बाल शिक्षा का अधिकार अधिनियम (RTE Act), 2009 की धारा 21(1) के अंतर्गत सभी सरकारी एवं सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालयों में विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) का गठन अनिवार्य किया गया है। सामुदायिक स्वामित्व और विकेंद्रीकृत लोकतांत्रिक प्रशासन को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कानून में दो अनिवार्य अनुपात निर्धारित किए गए हैं:
1. समिति के कुल सदस्यों में से कम से कम तीन-चौथाई (75%) सदस्य विद्यालय में नामांकित बच्चों के माता-पिता या कानूनी अभिभावक होने चाहिए। इसके साथ ही, इस 75% कोटे में वंचित समूहों और कमजोर वर्गों के अभिभावकों का आनुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्व अनिवार्य है।
2. समिति के कुल सदस्यों में से कम से कम पचास प्रतिशत (50%) सदस्य महिलाएँ होनी चाहिए।

विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि 50% का कोटा महिलाओं के आरक्षण के लिए है, न कि अभिभावकों के लिए (अभिभावकों के लिए 75% अनिवार्य है)। विकल्प (b) गलत है क्योंकि RTE नियमावली के अनुसार समिति का अध्यक्ष अभिभावक सदस्यों में से चुना जाता है, जबकि प्रधानाचार्य प्रायः सदस्य-सचिव होता है। विकल्प (d) गलत है क्योंकि स्थानीय निकायों के निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधियों का अनुपात शेष 25% गैर-अभिभावक सदस्यों का एक छोटा हिस्सा होता है, 25% नहीं।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Staffing' function in educational management:
I. It involves manpower planning, recruitment, selection, and placement.
II. It is a static, one-time exercise completed solely at the commencement of an academic session.
III. It encompasses induction, continuous training, and professional staff development.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I and III only
II and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Staffing is defined as the managerial function of acquiring, developing, maintaining, and retaining a competent workforce. Statement I is correct because staffing begins with analyzing human resource needs (manpower planning) followed by recruitment, applicant screening/selection, and appropriate placement. Statement II is incorrect because staffing is a continuous, dynamic managerial activity rather than a one-time event; unexpected vacancies, resignations, maternity leaves, retirements, and promotions necessitate ongoing staffing actions throughout the academic year. Statement III is correct because onboarding (induction), in-service teacher training, pedagogical workshops, and career development programs are integral components of modern educational staffing.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। शैक्षिक प्रबंधन में 'स्टाफिंग' (नियुक्तिकरण) एक निरंतर चलने वाला और व्यापक प्रबंधकीय कार्य है। कथन I सही है क्योंकि नियुक्तिकरण के अंतर्गत संस्था की कार्यबल आवश्यकताओं का आकलन (मानव संसाधन नियोजन), योग्य उम्मीदवारों की खोज (भर्ती), उपयुक्ततम का चयन और सही पद पर पदस्थापन शामिल है। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि नियुक्तिकरण केवल सत्र के प्रारंभ में होने वाली एकबारगी गतिविधि नहीं है; वर्षभर त्यागपत्र, स्थानांतरण, अवकाश या सेवानिवृत्ति के कारण रिक्तियां उत्पन्न होती रहती हैं, अतः यह एक सतत चलने वाली प्रक्रिया है। कथन III सही है क्योंकि नवनियुक्त शिक्षकों का अभिमुखीकरण (इंडक्शन), सेवाकालीन प्रशिक्षण (इन-सर्विस ट्रेनिंग) और निरंतर व्यावसायिक विकास नियुक्तिकरण का ही अनिवार्य भाग हैं। अतः केवल कथन I और III सही हैं।

questions.question_english: Which of the following is a primary characteristic of modern educational 'Supervision' as distinguished from traditional bureaucratic 'Inspection'?
options_english: It is authoritarian, fault-finding, and focused strictly on checking minimum statutory compliance.
It is a sporadic, episodic activity conducted primarily for confidential performance grading.
It relies exclusively on desk audits of written lesson plans rather than classroom observation.
It is collaborative, continuous, and aimed at instructional improvement and teacher professional growth.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). In educational leadership theory, modern 'Supervision' is sharply distinguished from traditional 'Inspection'. Traditional inspection (a colonial/bureaucratic relic) is typically authoritarian, sporadic, focused on fault-finding, policing rules, and enforcing bare minimum compliance. In contrast, modern instructional supervision is democratic, continuous, and collaborative. Its primary purpose is not to punish, but to provide pedagogical mentoring, instructional guidance, and constructive feedback that fosters the continuous professional growth of teachers and improves classroom learning outcomes. Option (a) defines traditional inspection. Option (b) describes sporadic bureaucratic auditing. Option (c) describes superficial clerical checking without instructional leadership.

questions.question_english: 'Management by Exception' is an administrative principle that states:

questions.explanation_english: Management by Exception (MBE) is a classical management principle asserting that senior administrators should concentrate their attention, time, and decision-making authority primarily on significant deviations or variances from established plans, budgets, or operational standards. Routine operational matters are delegated to and resolved autonomously by front-line personnel according to standardized policies. Senior management intervenes only when performance exceptionally exceeds or falls significantly short of established benchmarks. This prevents executive micromanagement and optimizes administrative focus. Thus, Option D is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: 'अपवाद द्वारा प्रबंधन' (Management by Exception - MBE) का सिद्धांत यह प्रतिपादित करता है कि उच्च स्तर के प्रबंधकों या प्रधानाचार्यों को अपने सीमित समय और ऊर्जा को दैनिक व सामान्य कार्यों में व्यर्थ नहीं करना चाहिए। सामान्य परिचालन संबंधी निर्णय पूर्व-निर्धारित नीतियों के अनुसार अधीनस्थों द्वारा ही लिए जाने चाहिए। उच्च नेतृत्व का हस्तक्षेप केवल तभी होना चाहिए जब कार्य-प्रदर्शन में निर्धारित मानकों, लक्ष्यों अथवा बजट से कोई गंभीर या असाधारण विचलन (Significant Deviation) दिखाई दे। इससे प्रबंधकों का समय बचता है और अधीनस्थों का सशक्तिकरण होता है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: In institutional timetable construction, the 'Principle of Incidence' (Fatigue and Alertness) primarily relates to which of the following practices?
options_english: Ensuring equal distribution of teaching periods among all academic faculty members
Scheduling cognitively challenging subjects during periods when student mental alertness is at its peak
Incorporating flexible provisions for substitution arrangements when teachers are absent
Accommodating the maximum number of classes within the existing physical classrooms
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In school administration and pedagogical time management, the 'Principle of Incidence' (also linked with the psychological laws of fatigue and rhythm) governs how subjects are sequenced across the school day based on students' physiological and cognitive alertness curves. Mental fatigue peaks towards the late afternoon; therefore, intellectually demanding and abstract subjects—such as Mathematics, Science, and English grammar—should be scheduled during earlier periods (typically periods 2, 3, or 4) when pupil concentration is highest. Lighter, expressive, and co-curricular subjects (such as Art, Physical Education, and Crafts) should be scheduled during later periods. Option (a) refers to the Principle of Justice/Equality in teacher workload. Option (c) describes substitution scheduling. Option (d) pertains to infrastructure utilization.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। विद्यालयी समय-सारणी (Time-table) निर्माण में 'घटना का सिद्धांत / थकान का सिद्धांत' (Principle of Incidence / Fatigue) विद्यार्थियों की मानसिक और शारीरिक ऊर्जा के मनोवैज्ञानिक विक्षेपण पर आधारित है। पूरे विद्यालय दिवस के दौरान बालकों की मानसिक सतर्कता और एकाग्रता एकसमान नहीं रहती; सुबह के दूसरे-तीसरे कालांश में मानसिक सतर्कता चरम पर होती है, जबकि दोपहर के बाद थकान बढ़ती है। इसलिए गणित, विज्ञान जैसे बौद्धिक रूप से कठिन और अमूर्त विषयों को प्रथमार्ध के उन कालांशों में रखा जाना चाहिए जब छात्र मानसिक रूप से सर्वाधिक सजग हों, तथा कला, शिल्प, शारीरिक शिक्षा जैसे हलके विषयों को अंतिम कालांशों में रखा जाना चाहिए। विकल्प (a) कार्यभार के न्यायसंगत वितरण का सिद्धांत है। विकल्प (c) स्थानापन्न व्यवस्था है। विकल्प (d) अवसंरचना के इष्टतम उपयोग से जुड़ा है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the concept and practice of 'Delegation' in organizational management:
I. Delegation involves assigning responsibility for duties and conferring requisite authority to subordinates.
II. A manager can delegate operational authority as well as abdicate ultimate accountability to subordinates.
III. Effective delegation improves employee morale, optimizes workload distribution, and develops future administrative leadership.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I and III only
II and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english:
Delegation in management involves assigning operational duties and empowering subordinates with the necessary authority to accomplish designated organizational tasks:
- Statement I is correct: Delegation consists of three core components: assignment of responsibility (duties), grant of authority (decision-making power), and creation of accountability.
- Statement II is incorrect: According to the fundamental administrative principle of the 'Absoluteness of Accountability', while a manager can delegate authority and operational duties, ultimate accountability cannot be delegated. A manager remains strictly answerable to higher authorities for the overall outcome and any lapses of subordinates.
- Statement III is correct: Effective delegation empowers staff, boosts job satisfaction and morale, facilitates managerial succession, and builds leadership capacity across the organization.
Therefore, statements I and III are correct, making option (b) the right choice.
questions.explanation_hindi:
प्रबंधन में प्रत्यायोजन (Delegation) का आशय वरिष्ठ अधिकारी द्वारा अपने अधीनस्थ कर्मचारियों को विशिष्ट कार्य सौंपने और उन्हें पूरा करने हेतु आवश्यक अधिकार (प्राधिकार) प्रदान करने से है:
- कथन I सही है: प्रत्यायोजन के तीन मूल तत्व होते हैं—कार्य का आवंटन (Responsibility), अधिकार प्रदान करना (Authority), और उत्तरदायित्व का सृजन।
- कथन II गलत है: प्रबंधन के 'जवाबदेही की निरपेक्षता के सिद्धांत' (Principle of Absoluteness of Accountability) के अनुसार, अधिकार और कार्य का प्रत्यायोजन तो किया जा सकता है, किंतु अंतिम जवाबदेही या उत्तरदायित्व (Accountability) को कभी प्रत्यायोजित नहीं किया जा सकता। किसी भी विफलता या अनियमितता के लिए उच्चाधिकारियों के प्रति अंतिम रूप से वह प्रबंधक ही जिम्मेदार रहता है जिसने कार्य प्रत्यायोजित किया था।
- कथन III सही है: सार्थक प्रत्यायोजन से कर्मचारियों की कार्यक्षमता एवं मनोबल में वृद्धि होती है, कार्यभार का समुचित वितरण होता है और संस्था में भविष्य के नेतृत्व का संवर्धन होता है।
अतः केवल कथन I और III सही हैं, जिससे विकल्प (b) सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: The 'Scalar Principle' in an organization dictates that:
options_english: Compensation must strictly follow predetermined formal salary grade structures across all staff tiers
Continuous unbroken line of authority connecting apex leaders to frontline staff
Administrative decision processes must be simplified to their lowest operational components
Supervisory span limits must expand or contract based on total active functional departments
questions.explanation_english: The Scalar Principle (formulated by Henri Fayol as the 'Scalar Chain' and elaborated by Mooney and Reiley) dictates that an organization must possess a continuous, unbroken line of authority and communication running vertically from the highest executive authority to the lowest operational ranks. This vertical chain ensures unambiguous reporting lines, establishes accountability, clarifies the hierarchy of command, and provides an orderly channel through which information and decisions flow. It does not dictate salary grades, operational simplification, or variable spans of control. Therefore, Option B is correct.

Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Educational management is regarded as both a science and an art.
Reason (R): It is founded upon a systematized body of knowledge and principles, while also requiring personal skill, intuition, and creativity in managing human resources.
In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Management is universally characterized by theorists as both a science and an art. It is a science because it possesses an organized, systematic body of knowledge, universal principles, scientific methods of inquiry, and cause-and-effect relationships. It is simultaneously an art because the successful application of these scientific principles requires personal competence, emotional intelligence, intuitive judgment, tactical adaptation, and situational creativity—especially in educational settings where the primary resource and focus are human beings (teachers, students, and parents). Because Reason (R) directly delineates the exact scientific and artistic attributes that justify Assertion (A), (R) is the true and correct explanation of (A).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। शैक्षिक प्रबंधन को विद्वानों द्वारा विज्ञान और कला दोनों का संगम माना गया है। यह 'विज्ञान' इसलिए है क्योंकि यह सुव्यवस्थित ज्ञान, परीक्षण योग्य सिद्धांतों, कारणों और प्रभावों के संबंधों तथा व्यवस्थित पद्धतियों पर आधारित है। साथ ही यह 'कला' इसलिए है क्योंकि इन सैद्धांतिक नियमों का व्यावहारिक प्रयोग प्रशासक के व्यक्तिगत कौशल, संवेगात्मक समझ, रचनात्मकता और परिस्थितियों के अनुरूप व्यावहारिक निर्णय लेने की क्षमता पर निर्भर करता है, विशेषकर जब विषय मानवीय व्यवहार हो। चूँकि कारण (R) सीधे तौर पर अभिकथन (A) के विज्ञान और कला होने के मूल तत्वों को स्पष्ट करता है, इसलिए (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.explanation_english: In-Service Teacher Education (INSET) encompasses continuous professional development (CPD) programs specifically tailored for active, practicing educators. questions.question_english: Which classical administrative principle formulated by Henri Fayol dictates that employees must subordinate their personal agendas and sectional preferences to the collective goals and mission of the educational institution?
options_english: Absolute Unity of Administrative Command
Equitable Remuneration of Staff Personnel
Subordination of Individual Interest to General Interest
Systematic Functional Division of Work
questions.explanation_english:
Henri Fayol's sixth principle of management, 'Subordination of Individual Interest to General Interest', stipulates that the goals, welfare, and mission of the overall organization must always take precedence over the personal interests, ambitions, and convenience of individual employees or smaller factions. In educational institutions, teachers and administrative personnel must place student welfare, institutional excellence, and academic standards above personal convenience or departmental rivalries.
In contrast:
- Unity of Command states that an employee should receive orders from only one superior (Option A),
- Remuneration of Personnel demands fair and motivating compensation (Option B), and
- Division of Work emphasizes specialized roles to maximize operational productivity (Option D).
questions.explanation_hindi: हेनरी फेयोल का 'सामान्य हित के अधीन व्यक्तिगत हित' का सिद्धांत यह स्पष्ट करता है कि किसी संगठन में संपूर्ण संस्था का सामूहिक कल्याण और उसके मुख्य लक्ष्य किसी भी व्यक्तिगत कर्मचारी या गुट के निजी हितों व प्राथमिकताओं से सर्वोपरि होने चाहिए। किसी विद्यालय में शिक्षकों, विभागाध्यक्षों और प्रशासनिक कर्मचारियों को अपनी व्यक्तिगत प्राथमिकताओं से ऊपर उठकर विद्यार्थियों के सर्वांगीण विकास और विद्यालय की शैक्षणिक उत्कृष्टता के लिए समर्पित भाव से कार्य करना चाहिए। अन्य विकल्पों में 'आदेश की एकता' (एक ही अधिकारी से आदेश मिलना), 'पारिश्रमिक' (उचित मानदेय) तथा 'कार्य विभाजन' (विशेषज्ञता के आधार पर कार्य वितरण) शामिल हैं।

questions.question_english:
A newly joined Principal observes that the school culture is highly toxic; teachers do not share resources, complain endlessly about students, and resist any new pedagogical initiatives. Realizing that structural changes alone will not work, the Principal decides to focus on 'Espoused Values' and 'Basic Assumptions' to shift the culture over three years.
Whose model of organizational culture is the Principal utilizing?
options_english: Kurt Lewin
Henri Fayol
Douglas McGregor
Edgar Schein
questions.explanation_english: Edgar Schein formulated the definitive three-level model of organizational culture: (1) Artifacts (visible surface structures and behaviors), (2) Espoused Values (conscious strategies, stated philosophies, and goals articulated by leadership), and (3) Basic Underlying Assumptions (unconscious, deeply ingrained beliefs, habits of perception, and premises that form the true essence of culture). By recognizing that superficial administrative changes will fail without transforming shared values and unconscious assumptions, the Principal is directly applying Edgar Schein's theoretical model. Lewin formulated 3-step change, Fayol created 14 management principles, and McGregor developed Theory X and Y. Therefore, Option D is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: एमआईटी के प्रख्यात संगठनात्मक मनोवैज्ञानिक एडगर शाइन (Edgar Schein) ने संगठनात्मक संस्कृति का त्रि-स्तरीय मॉडल प्रतिपादित किया था: 1. दृश्यमान प्रतीक व कलाकृतियाँ (Artifacts - सतही स्तर), 2. अंगीकृत मूल्य (Espoused Values - घोषित रणनीतियाँ, दर्शन और नियम), तथा 3. मूलभूत अंतर्निहित मान्यताएँ (Basic Underlying Assumptions - अचेतन, स्वतः सिद्ध और गहराई से जमी हुई मान्यताएँ जो वास्तविक व्यवहार को निर्धारित करती हैं)। विद्यालय के नकारात्मक माहौल को बदलने के लिए अंगीकृत मूल्यों और अंतर्निहित मान्यताओं को लक्षित करना सीधे तौर पर एडगर शाइन के सांस्कृतिक मॉडल का अनुप्रयोग है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
